candidate_sentences.text: This top-line improvement was driven by the fibreboard production and sales segment, which grew by 127 thousand euros, or 7.3%, from 1.73 million euros in the first quarter of 2025 to 1.86 million euros in the first quarter of 2026.

Within geographical performance, sales to European Union customers rose from 1.639 million euros to 1.781 million euros, supported primarily by Finnish DIY stores, whose order volume increased by 241 thousand euros from 614 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2025 to 855 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2026.
Sales to African markets stood at 62 thousand euros compared to 87 thousand euros in the prior-year period, while sales to Asia were 13 thousand euros compared to zero in the first quarter of 2025.

The Group recorded a consolidated EBITDA of negative 395 thousand euros, with an EBITDA margin of negative 21%, worsening from an EBITDA of negative 85 thousand euros and an EBITDA margin of negative 5% in the first quarter of 2025.

The fibreboard segment recorded an EBITDA of negative 321 thousand euros compared to negative 62 thousand euros in the previous year, and a net loss of 496 thousand euros compared to a net loss of 204 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2025.

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S3 states that the fibreboard production and sales segment grew by 127 thousand euros from 1.73 million to 1.86 million euros. However, sentence S8 states that the fibreboard segment recorded an EBITDA of negative 321 thousand euros compared to negative 62 thousand euros in the previous year. This implies that while revenue increased, the EBITDA loss widened significantly, creating a logical tension between revenue growth and deteriorating profitability within the same segment.

The fibreboard segment recorded an EBITDA of negative 321 thousand euros compared to negative 62 thousand euros in the previous year, and a net loss of 496 thousand euros compared to a net loss of 204 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2025.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear structure detailing financial performance, operational challenges, and market conditions. However, there is a noticeable tension between the revenue growth reported in S3 and the significant deterioration in EBITDA and net loss for the same fibreboard segment in S8. While the summary explains external factors (factory shutdown, energy prices) that impacted profitability, the juxtaposition of revenue growth with a sharp increase in losses within the same segment creates an internal logical inconsistency. The rest of the summary flows logically, with explanations for financial performance and clear organization of topics.
